carousel.title: India Presents 2036 Olympics Bid to IOC, Betting on Ahmedabad
carousel.excerpt: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, P T Usha and P V Sindhu front Thursday's online pitch to the Future Host Commission, built on Ahmedabad's 2030 Commonwealth Games infrastructure and a run of 36 international events.
carousel.image_caption: The Sabarmati riverfront in Ahmedabad, the proposed host city in India's bid for the 2036 Olympic Games.
carousel.nri_angle: A 2036 Ahmedabad Games would be India's first Olympics; the host will not be chosen until 2029, so this is the start of a three-year campaign.

carousel.title: Infosys Becomes World's First Organization Assessed at CMMI AI Maturity Level 5
carousel.excerpt: An assessment by Benchmarked Pty Ltd, a CMMI Institute licensed partner, sampled Infosys projects from a pool of more than 1,000 across service lines and geographies — and placed the Bengaluru-headquartered company at the AI maturity model's highest level.
carousel.image_caption: A glass pyramid building on the Infosys campus in Bengaluru. Infosys said an assessment sampling more than 1,000 of its projects placed it at Level 5 of the CMMI AI Maturity Model, the model's highest level.
carousel.nri_angle: A Bengaluru-headquartered IT major employing many Indian-origin technologists worldwide has set the first benchmark under the CMMI AI maturity model.

carousel.title: Dow Erases 1,100-Point Drop to Close Higher as Bargain Hunters Step In
carousel.excerpt: The Nasdaq fell more than 4% early on Wednesday in an AI-led selloff sharpened by new US tariff proposals — then recovered most of the loss, closing down just 0.62% as value stocks outperformed ahead of Thanksgiving.
carousel.image_caption: Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange in New York. US indexes recovered most of a steep early loss on November 25, 2026, with the Dow closing higher and the Nasdaq down 0.62%.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-American investors holding US index and AI stocks saw a 4% intraday Nasdaq fall narrow to a 0.62% close, with markets shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.
